// PW-CONTENT-02 A3 probe — the pricing JSON-LD offer built by parsing a formatted string back.
// With a Greek price string «4,99 €» this reads 499. The guard must flag it.
softwareApplicationJsonLd(
    plans.map((plan) => ({
        name: plan.name.el,
        price: plan.pricing.monthly.amount.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""),
    }))
)
